p.src: For the Chief Musician. Set to “The Lilies.” A contemplation by the sons of Korah. A wedding song.

en: For the Chief Musician. Set to “The Lilies.” A contemplation by the sons of Korah. A wedding song.
u.src: For the Chief Musician. Set to “The Lilies.” A contemplation by the sons of Korah. A wedding song.

p.src: 1  My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.

en: My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.
u.src: 1  My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.

p.src: 2  You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.

en: You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.
u.src: 2  You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.

p.src: 3  Strap your sword on your thigh, O mighty one, in your splendor and your majesty.

en: Strap your sword on your thigh, O mighty one, in your splendor and your majesty.
u.src: 3  Strap your sword on your thigh, O mighty one, in your splendor and your majesty.

p.src: 4  In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand display awesome deeds.

en: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand display awesome deeds.
u.src: 4  In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand display awesome deeds.

p.src: 5  Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king’s enemies.

en: Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king’s enemies.
u.src: 5  Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king’s enemies.

p.src: 6  Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.

en: Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.
u.src: 6  Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.

p.src: 7  You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.

en: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.
u.src: 7  You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.

p.src: 8  All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made you glad.

en: All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made you glad.
u.src: 8  All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made you glad.

p.src: 9  Kings’ daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.

en: Kings’ daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.
u.src: 9  Kings’ daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.

p.src: 10  Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father’s house.

en: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father’s house.
u.src: 10  Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father’s house.

p.src: 11  So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.

en: So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.
u.src: 11  So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.

p.src: 12  The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor.

en: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor.
u.src: 12  The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor.

p.src: 13  The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.

en: The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.
u.src: 13  The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.

p.src: 14  She shall be led to the king in embroidered work. The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you.

en: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work. The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you.
u.src: 14  She shall be led to the king in embroidered work. The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you.

p.src: 15  With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king’s palace.

en: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king’s palace.
u.src: 15  With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king’s palace.

p.src: 16  Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.

en: Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.
u.src: 16  Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.

p.src: 17  I will make your name to be remembered in all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever.

en: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever.
u.src: 17  I will make your name to be remembered in all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever.
